validation.method: three-fold grouped cross-validation within the 384 established training cases

pod.inputField: static FEM displacement minus analytical Euler-Bernoulli beam field

optimizerStage.initialization: same MATLAB RNG seed, fold, and selected architecture; initial parameter hash recorded

gprReference.fitScope: same outer-fold training rows, POD basis, and standardized coefficients as MLP
gprReference.hyperparameterSelection: fixed before outer-fold evaluation; no outer-fold tuning
gprReference.note: The existing GPR package implementation standardizes from training rows and fixes Sigma=1e-4; this is not the MLP weight-decay penalty.

selection.primaryMetric: mean relative weighted field L2 error over the pooled outer validation cases and seeds
selection.architectureTieBreak: within absolute 1e-12, choose first listed architecture (simplest candidate)

technicalPilot.purpose: interface, fold, initialization, reconstruction, metric, resume and runtime estimate only; all pilot runs are excluded from candidate scores

campaign.finalTrainingDataScope: all and only the established 384 training cases

outputPolicy: immutable run artifacts; verify configuration, source-data, and code hashes before resuming
